evidenceSummary.excerpt: According to the more ancient Greek conception, Venus was the daughter of Jupiter and Dione, goddess of moisture; but Hesiod says that she came from the foam of the sea, and was therefore called by the Greeks Aphrodite--the foam-born.
Chorus to Aphrodite in "Atalanta in Calydon" ALGERNON C. SWINBURNE
Aphrodite in "Epic of Hades" LEWIS MORRIS
Venus of Milo EDWARD R. SILL
